analysis.one_line_summary: Static promo ad for WavyTalk Power Wave offering 36% off with code NV10, featuring a model holding the tool with styled wavy hair.
analysis.full_description: A square static promotional graphic showing a young female model with medium-length styled wavy brunette hair holding the pink WavyTalk Power Wave tool. The background is a clean solid off-white studio backdrop. On the left side, the 'WAVYTALK' logo is featured at the top, followed by large typography reading 'Power Wave', a promo code callout 'USE CODE: NV10' with a neon pink highlight, and a large bright pink circular badge reading '36% OFF'.

scenes.visual: A young female model posing with wavy brunette hair holding the pink WavyTalk Power Wave styling tool in her hand against a white background, next to graphic overlays displaying the brand, product name, discount code, and percentage discount.
scenes.action: Static pose holding the product upright toward the viewer while looking directly into the camera.
